reviews.title: Bright Colours and Easy Clean-up!
reviews.body: The 40-pack of Crayola washable markers was the perfect buy for my daughter, who loves colouring! There is a great variety of colours, but the best part is how easy it is to clean up from their hands, clothes, or even furniture and walls. Highly recommended!!!
